name: Imouto ni! Sukumizu Kisetara Nugasanai!
original_name: 妹に！スク水着せたら脱がさないっ！
source:
Takuto loves school swimsuits. One day, Moyu, his younger sister, suddenly tells him, "You like school swimsuits, right? Shall I wear one for you?" Like this, their secret photo party begins.... 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090304202732/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1008707]Eroge Shop[/url]]
